status: REFERENCE — not frozen, not a registration input until D-2 closes
purpose: Canonical PIT regulatory auto-rejection band table for IDX regular-board equity securities. Separates documentary primary verification from behavioural corroboration and NEVER conflates them.

confidence_vocabulary.note: Adopted verbatim from the repository's existing precedent, data/walkforward.db::idx80_reconstitution_periods, so the two PIT reference tables grade evidence on one scale.
confidence_vocabulary.PRIMARY_VERIFIED: the issuing authority's own document was retrieved and read
confidence_vocabulary.CROSS_VALIDATED: multiple independent contemporaneous sources agree; issuing document not retrieved
confidence_vocabulary.BRACKETED_RECONSTRUCTED: derived by delta/inference from an adjacent verified state

hard_rule: behaviourally_corroborated=true NEVER implies primary_verified=true. A regularity in prices is evidence about the world; a decree is evidence about the rule. They are different objects and are recorded in different fields.
scope_note: Applies to regular-board (Papan Utama / Pengembangan / Ekonomi Baru) equity securities, ETF and DIRE. Papan Pemantauan Khusus trades by full call auction on a DIFFERENT mechanism (+/-10% symmetric above Rp10, +/-Rp1 at Rp1-10) and is NOT covered by any row below. IPO first trading day carries 2x bands referenced to the offer price and is NOT covered.

price_tiers.basis: previous closing price (regular board reference price)
price_tiers.tier_stability: ASSUMED CONSTANT ACROSS REGIMES — UNVERIFIED. LC-PM-0009 explicitly flags this ('no verification of whether any tier boundaries changed across regimes'). Not corroborated by this audit either.

regimes.behavioural_evidence: HYP-PM-0008_R3_BOUNDARY_BEHAVIOURAL_AUDIT_2026-09-14 section E.1: across 2023-01..2023-05, 67148 observations over five months, the most negative daily move is exactly -10.0% in four of five months and -9.9% in the fifth. A -7% floor is breached on hundreds of observations; a -10% floor is never breached.
regimes.discrepancy: LC-PM-0009 states ARB=7%. Local OHLCV behaviour for 2023-01..2023-05 indicates -10%. Most likely an undocumented intermediate relaxation -7% -> -10% at an unknown date before 2023-01. NOT RESOLVED. Bounding it requires scanning 2021-07-05..2022-12-31, which was outside the audited window and was not performed.

regimes.source: Kep-00055/BEI/03-2023 (issued 2023-03-30), staged implementation, Tahap I; LC-PM-0009 + contemporaneous secondary reporting
regimes.behavioural_evidence: section E.1/E.2: 42112 observations over 2023-06..2023-08 with NO move beyond -15.0%; the -15% floor binds to within 0.43pp on each of the five sessions preceding 2023-09-04. First session 2023-06-05 prints exactly -15.00% where the prior session (2023-05-31) bottomed at -9.93% with zero moves beyond -10.5%.
regimes.boundary_precision: SESSION-EXACT. 2023-05-31 is the last R1 session, 2023-06-05 the first R2 session; 2023-06-01/02 were IDX holidays and 06-03/04 a weekend.
regimes.role: POSITIVE CONTROL — recovering this independently-documented boundary validated the detector before the R2->R3 boundary was assessed.

regimes.arb: symmetric: equal and opposite to ARA (-35/-25/-20 by tier)
regimes.source: Kep-00055/BEI/03-2023 (issued 2023-03-30), Auto Rejection Simetris Tahap II; LC-PM-0009 + contemporaneous secondary reporting
regimes.behavioural_evidence: section E.2/E.3: last R2 session 2023-09-01 bottoms at -14.57% with ZERO moves beyond -15.5%; first R3 session 2023-09-04 prints -34.94% with 2 moves beyond -15.5%. 103 'R3-only' moves follow (beyond flat -15%, inside the symmetric tier), 0 before. 41 of 104 land within 1.0pp of their exact tier floor, 20 within 0.2pp; they sort correctly across all three tiers (70 at 25%, 32 at 35%, 2 at 20%); 74 distinct tickers over 50 sessions.
regimes.boundary_precision: SESSION-EXACT. 2023-09-02/03 was a weekend, so 2023-09-01 and 2023-09-04 are adjacent sessions and no intermediate date is admissible.
regimes.role: CONTROL ARM of the HYP-PM-0008 primary contrast

regimes.ara: tiered 35/25/20 — UNCHANGED across the R3->R4 switch
regimes.source: Kep-00003/BEI/04-2025 (Perubahan Peraturan Nomor II-A), established and effective 2025-04-08
regimes.source_quality: Q3 secondary; same-day pre-open national financial press (Kontan, 2025-04-08 08:51 WIB) reporting decree number, effective date, 15% for 'seluruh rentang harga', and enumerated scope (Papan Utama, Pengembangan, Ekonomi Baru, ETF, DIRE)
regimes.behavioural_evidence: dataset_b/artifacts/OUTSIDE_BAND_INVESTIGATION_v1.json: a naive flat -15% ARB applied across the Dataset B window produces 15 breaches, 15/15 resolved, 0 unresolved; 13 sub-band down-moves are ALL dated before 2025-04-08 (range 2025-01-23..2025-03-18) against observed symmetric floors of -20/-25/-35%, and ZERO occur on or after 2025-04-08.
regimes.boundary_precision: BOUNDED, NOT SESSION-EXACT, from local data alone: the last observed >15% down-move is 2025-03-18, so behaviour bounds the switch to (2025-03-18, first post-switch session]. The exact 2025-04-08 date rests on same-day secondary reporting.
regimes.compound_treatment: 2025-04-08 ALSO re-tiered the market-wide trading halt from a single 5% JCI drop to 8%/15%/20%. LC-PM-0009 condition 5 requires treating this as a compound treatment; HYP-PM-0008_SPEC section 7 exclusion E6 removes sessions where IHSG fell >= 8%.
regimes.role: TREATMENT ARM of the HYP-PM-0008 primary contrast
